items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...there's a version of 'Midnight' on the album that I have with Savannah Churchill. Do you know anything about that?

ctx.x: No, they were arrangements made I did "Yes, I'm Coming, Virginia" by Benny. / And I enjoyed it and it's only recently that I am, more or less, received as a singer of popular tunes. And even now when I perform they'll holler our "Loch Lomond".

I notice, I have a record at home of some performances from the Benny Carter Band when it was on the west coast and there's a version of "Midnight" on the album that I have with Savannah Churchill. Do you know anything about that?
